meta.title: What winning and losing vendors see after the award
gaps: The prepared state contains only one invited vendor, so it cannot reliably provide both Vendor A as a losing vendor and Vendor B as the winning vendor for the same event.
The catalog has no assertion for the awarded quantity specifically; expect_api_value quantity reads the event line-item quantity, not necessarily the awarded quantity.
The catalog has no dedicated step to verify the purchase order in the vendor portal after award.
The catalog cannot directly assert that neither vendor can see the other vendor's price without a known competing price value.

plan.title: Winning and Losing Vendor Award Visibility

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event without recreating or changing its state.
Switch to the named winning vendor's supplier portal while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the awarded event in Vendor B's portal overview.
Assert that the winning vendor sees the event as awarded.
Assert that the winning vendor's own bid amount is shown.
Switch to the named losing vendor's supplier portal for the closest available comparison.
Open the same prepared event in Vendor A's portal overview.
Assert the losing vendor view reports that it was not awarded, if that vendor is available in the prepared state.
